channel.title: WaveSurvivor Updates
channel.description: Official WaveSurvivor patch notes from Haider Games

item.title: v0.2.74 - DPS effect audit and effective movement readout
item.description: Show temporary Momentum in offline current speed and verify Mastery and permanent Stat effects without changing combat balance.

item.title: v0.2.73 - District 3 supplies pressure restored
item.description: Restore District 3 pacing with one shared spawn budget and begin supplies pressure only when the player first enters the zone.

item.title: v0.2.72 - District 1 remaining-enemy progress bar
item.description: Keep the D1 cleanup count centered inside its existing objective track, with fill that advances through deaths, recycling and Continue.

item.title: v0.2.71 - Sliding route doors and District 3 gameplay
item.description: Slide into District 3, earn a calm final delivery through cleanup, and face a stronger hidden ambush with pressure from multiple directions.

item.title: v0.2.70 - D1 cleanup count and Normal escape recycling
item.description: Show living post-repair survivors and recycle engaged Normals faster after players escape, preserving nearby combat lifetime and finite enemy ownership.

item.title: v0.2.69 - D5 siege pacing and station durability
item.description: Stronger siege stations, paired early-wave Hounds, clearer intermissions and one Final Warning announcement preserve the chaotic Final Wave.

item.title: v0.2.68 - Chapter trigger visibility and enemy visual detail
item.description: Hide Chapter transition helper meshes, restore neutral D5 Throwers and recover authored enemy surface detail while retaining the gold Core.

item.title: v0.2.67 - Practice motion and District 3 ambush flow
item.description: Smooth Practice target deceleration and a saved, player-triggered District 3 finale with the original Chapter warning.

item.title: v0.2.66 - D1 final pressure and Primary balance
item.description: Slightly ease the final D1 repair tier, clarify survivor cleanup, widen Normal engagement and balance Primary Mastery and Lifesteal.

item.title: v0.2.65 - Chapter Normal engagement recycling
item.description: Long-kited Chapter Normals recycle without kill credit while finite encounters retain every unpaid kill.

item.title: v0.2.64 - Chapter progression, delivery pressure and siege polish
item.description: Retire permanent Movement Speed with a one-time refund, scale Chapter Normals by encounter, sustain D3 delivery pressure and clarify D5 pacing and colors.

item.title: v0.2.63 - District 1 Communications placement cleanup
item.description: Communications uses the latest central authored position, with matching repair, waypoint and minimap guidance.

item.title: v0.2.62 - District 5 Thrower suppression and reboot
item.description: D5 siege Throwers become persistent tactical threats: disable them temporarily, watch the warning, and preserve their state through resume.

item.title: v0.2.61 - District 5 siege presentation polish
item.description: Readable Core health and Thrower states, distinct wave transitions and the established final-wave warning.

item.title: v0.2.60 - District 5 finite Archive Core siege
item.description: An authored Core defense with an opening clear, three finite waves, distinct enemy threats and resumable progress.

item.title: v0.2.59 - PracticeMachine launch feel polish
item.description: A larger initial interaction area and fast-launch, slower-descent timing along the existing high arcs.

item.title: v0.2.58 - Minimap facing cone and waypoint proximity
item.description: Show camera heading on the north-up minimap and hide redundant nearby destination waypoints.

item.title: v0.2.57 - District 3 chase escalation and ambush warning
item.description: A longer second supply chase and a saved gate-opening/red-warning finale add escalation while preserving the existing District 3 objective and combat composition.

item.title: v0.2.56 - Shared Chapter HUD regression repair
item.description: Repair the objective-area rendering dependency that interrupted shared Chapter HUD updates.

item.title: v0.2.55 - District 3 Hounds and moving supplies
item.description: District 3 introduces Hounds, two timed supply-zone chases, a final delivery hold and a finite mixed ambush.

item.title: v0.2.54 - Communications objective marker readability
item.description: Hide redundant nearby waypoints and show the actual Communications zone beneath the player arrow.

item.title: v0.2.53 - District 2 final polish
item.description: Twenty opening Normals, a larger PracticeMachine interaction footprint, higher target arcs and shadow-free HP-bar graphics.

item.title: v0.2.52 - Open District 3 as soon as District 2 is secured
item.description: D2 completion immediately opens the entire route into D3, including Continue restoration, while preserving safe destination closure.

item.title: v0.2.51 - Primed Throwers and persistent payload targeting
item.description: Throwers begin loaded with a one-second opening warning, and carried Normals remain targetable throughout their flight lifecycle.

item.title: v0.2.50 - Faster PracticeMachine targets
item.description: PracticeMachine targets travel in 3 seconds while group gating and launch delays remain unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.49 - Chapter floor glare reduction
item.description: Rougher Chapter district and corridor floors reduce specular glare while preserving wall response, blue lighting and reflections.

item.title: v0.2.48 - Chapter environment lighting foundation
item.description: Chapter 1 gains editable night lighting, soft directional shadows, subtle fog and restrained post processing, with four entrance accents.

item.title: v0.2.47 - District 2 aim challenge and Thrower assault
item.description: A 15-Normal opening leads directly into the existing aim challenge and four-Thrower assault, with Hounds retired from District 2.

item.title: v0.2.46 - District 1 stationary Communications defense
item.description: District 1 becomes a stationary 0–50 hold with escalating Normal pressure, survivor cleanup and Finalize Repairs, replacing the moving phase and separate ambush.

item.title: v0.2.45 - DPS Mastery capstone swap
item.description: Micro-Grenade gains close-range self-healing, while Bullet Rain gains a refreshing slow field, preserving saved node ownership and other tuning.

item.title: v0.2.44 - Current permanent Stats bonuses
item.description: Every NewMenu Stats card shows the accumulated purchased bonus, with clearer max-rank presentation and unchanged next-rank gates, costs and recovery choices.

item.title: v0.2.43 - Open forward routes with transition waypoints
item.description: Forward routes are visibly open when next-District navigation activates, while existing entry and safe door-closing rules remain intact.

item.title: v0.2.42 - Chapter objectives and deeper arena entry
item.description: Clearer District 1 combat objectives, uncertain ambush progress, deeper District 2/4/5 commitment and an open route toward District 3.

item.title: v0.2.41 - Permanent progression purchase gates
item.description: Broader current Stat and Mastery ownership now gates deeper purchases across the Chapter, with clear lock explanations and existing saves preserved.

item.title: v0.2.40 - North-up minimap and player visibility
item.description: Chapter minimap remains north-up while the player arrow rotates with facing and draws above overlapping markers, preserving District and corridor framing.

item.title: v0.2.39 - Safer Mastery reset and clearer enemy HP bars
item.description: Mastery reset is separated from Unlock, and larger enemy HP bars improve combat readability.

item.title: v0.2.38 - Chapter transition framing and NewMenu exits
item.description: Inter-District corridors receive precise navigation preview frames, and all New Chapter menu exits now return to NewMenu while preserving saves and progression.

item.title: v0.2.37 - District floor arrival and encounter grace
item.description: Districts 3 through 5 now wait for actual floor arrival and three seconds of grace before encounter spawning, with saved grace and existing door safety preserved.

item.title: v0.2.36 - Active-District minimap framing
item.description: Chapter minimap focuses on the current entered District while retaining earlier discovery, static framing, heading-up rotation and shared marker projection.

item.title: v0.2.35 - Static revealed-map minimap framing
item.description: Chapter minimap frames all revealed floors with a stable heading-safe scale, a moving player marker and no player-follow or Core proximity zoom.

item.title: v0.2.34 - District 2 sustained Hound pressure tuning
item.description: Post-machine Hound pressure reduced to one spawn opportunity every 4 seconds, preserving the 8-Hound introduction, enemy stats, four Throwers and all other District 2 pacing.

item.title: v0.2.33 - District 2 aim-trainer flight speed test
item.description: Practice target flight duration reduced from 6 to 4 seconds while initial delay, between-group cadence, sequencing and resolution gating remain unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.32 - Two-point Chapter checkpoint transitions
item.description: Authored checkpoints now own completion, rewards, saving and results; entry triggers start the next district, Continue resumes at entry and rear doors wait for actual floor arrival.

item.title: v0.2.31 - Minimap camera clamp stability
item.description: Continuity and coverage hysteresis prevent competing Chapter minimap frames from switching sides during camera rotation.

item.title: v0.2.30 - District 2 Hound pressure reduction
item.description: Fewer introductory Hounds and half-rate sustained Hound pressure, with individual Hound behavior and practice-target flight settings preserved.

item.title: v0.2.29 - Micro-Grenade base damage tuning
item.description: Fresh Chapter Micro-Grenade base damage reduced to 20 with its 10-second base cooldown and existing AD, Stats and Mastery composition preserved.

item.title: v0.2.28 - Clamped Chapter minimap camera
item.description: Heading-up minimap framing follows useful revealed map space, stops at boundaries and allows the player marker to move within the viewport.

item.title: v0.2.27 - Forward-view minimap framing
item.description: The Chapter minimap gives more space ahead with a fixed lower-center player anchor, aligned artwork and markers, and preserved District reveal and Core zoom.

item.title: v0.2.26 - Normal HP 60 and Bullet Rain tick tuning
item.description: Chapter Normal HP is now 60; Bullet Rain deals 7 base damage per tick for 84 total. Prototype balance pending manual testing.

item.title: 0.2.25 - Player-centered minimap and District reveal
item.description: The Chapter minimap keeps the player centered, reveals areas through progression and uses larger markers without exposing future Districts during zoom.

item.title: 0.2.24 - Replay completion handoff
item.description: Chapter replay now reaches the District results panel with zero rewards and Continue / Main Menu choices, while preserving canonical progression.

item.title: v0.2.23 - Chapter heading-up minimap and larger markers
item.description: Camera look now points up on the Chapter minimap, with larger markers and preserved zoom, tracking and edge indicators.

item.title: 0.2.22 - Progression test polish
item.description: 840 first-clear Credits per pre-boss mission and automatic same-branch DPS Mastery node selection after purchasing.

item.title: 0.2.21 - Chapter Normal HP-only balance pass
item.description: Chapter Normal HP is now 50 while movement speed remains 4.5 and damage remains 5. Five fresh-DPS primary hits; all other combat and pacing preserved.

item.title: v0.2.20 - Prototype pre-boss Chapter mission rewards
item.description: 800 Credits and 200 DPS Mastery XP per first clear of missions 1-1 through 1-5, totaling exactly 4,000 Credits and 1,000 Mastery XP. Prototype economy, balance pending.

item.title: v0.2.19 - Development full progression reset
item.description: A confirmed NewMenu testing reset restores a fresh profile and Chapter 1-1 while preserving preferences. Development tooling only.

item.title: v0.2.18 - Developer God Mode shortcut conflict fix
item.description: Chapter God Mode no longer shares Backspace with the runtime Rendering Debugger. Scoped F12 debugger controls preserve intentional debugging.

item.title: v0.2.17 - Chapter developer God Mode
item.description: Developer-only Chapter shortcut for invulnerability and instant ability cooldowns, with a small status indicator. Combat balance and progression remain unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.16 - Chapter Normal HP and Bullet Rain tuning
item.description: Chapter Normal HP is now 70. Bullet Rain deals 10 base damage per tick for 120 total. All other balance and mission pacing are unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.15 - District 1 completion handoff
item.description: Three authored corridor points separate durable first-clear rewards, middle-checkpoint results and existing District 2 entry. Prototype rewards are balance pending.

item.title: v0.2.14 - Chapter Normal HP tuning
item.description: Chapter Normal HP reduced to 80 while movement speed remains 4.5 and damage remains 5. Fresh DPS and all other combat and mission pacing remain unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.13 - Mission 1-1 communications repair pacing
item.description: A 50-point communications objective with 25 static and 25 moving points, plus 4-second static and 2-second moving enemy pressure. Combat balance is unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.12 - Chapter Normal HP and movement tuning
item.description: Chapter Normal enemies move at 4.5 and have 90 HP while damage remains 5. Fresh DPS and all other combat systems are unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.11 - DPS point-blank hit detection
item.description: Camera-side primary hit detection fixes close-range blind spots while preserving the authored weapon muzzle and tracer presentation.

item.title: v0.2.10 - Chapter Normal pursuit tuning
item.description: Chapter Normal movement reduced from 5.0 to 4.8 while retaining 100 HP, 5 damage and all other balance values.

item.title: v0.2.9 - Chapter Rank-0 combat baseline
item.description: Prototype fresh DPS, Normal, Hound and stationary Thrower tuning, fixed Thrower cadence and a finite Bullet Rain tick budget. Pending manual feel testing.

item.title: v0.2.8 - Chapter HUD cleanup
item.description: Retired run XP stays hidden and Chapter Armor appears only when live effective Armor capacity exists.

item.title: v0.2.7 - Chapter temporary cards retired
item.description: New Chapter 1 uses Permanent Stats and DPS Mastery, with safe retirement of run XP, temporary cards and obsolete card save restoration.

item.title: v0.2.6 - Chapter mission replay
item.description: Completed Chapter missions can replay fresh encounters while preserving furthest campaign progress and permanent profile.

item.title: v0.2.5 - NewMenu readability pass
item.description: Saved Player Level beside Credits, wrapped Mastery details and clearer text spacing across the existing 6 × 2 Stats grid.

item.title: v0.2.4 - Permanent DPS Stats prototype
item.description: Twelve Credit-based permanent DPS Stats cards, exclusive recovery paths and confirmed Armor recharge/refill timings in the development NewMenu.

item.title: v0.2.3 - DPS Mastery prototype and Story reset
item.description: A persistent direct-spend DPS Mastery prototype in NewMenu, with free respec and confirmed active-campaign Story reset.

item.title: v0.2.2 - Chapter menu development shell
item.description: A separate, plain NewMenu development scene for Chapter 1 navigation, shared Credits and recent updates, while the production menu remains unchanged.

item.title: v0.2.1 - Persistent progression foundation
item.description: A shared permanent profile foundation for Player XP, Player Level, Credits and direct-spend DPS Mastery XP, plus retirement of DPS fire-rate stacking.

item.title: v0.1.99 - Temporary Chapter 1-5 skeleton
item.description: Save-first district transitions, temporary 50-Normal missions, a Core/Thrower placeholder finale and compatible Story suspension.

item.title: v0.1.98 - District 2 encounter pressure
item.description: Surviving Throwers accelerate through a fixed timing ladder, with one-second uncapped prototype Hound pressure and unchanged damage/flight.

item.title: v0.1.97 - Story navigation and Practice guidance
item.description: Persistent corridor waypoints, physical District 2 minimap handoff, arrival breathing, target orientation and prompt District 3 guidance.

item.title: v0.1.96 - Mid-mission Story save and resume
item.description: Save & Exit preserves the current Story mission, enemies, Practice and player build together; Continue resumes the suspended session in its own save slot.

item.title: v0.1.95 - Three Offline Story campaigns
item.description: Three independent Story saves, last-played Continue, safe campaign migration and confirmed individual deletion.

item.title: v0.1.94 - Story objective communication
item.description: Clear replay and role labels, temporary secured announcements, fixed survivor countdowns and authored District 3 navigation.

item.title: v0.1.93 - District 2 combat polish
item.description: Grounded stationary Throwers, stronger Hound pressure, reliable grenade contacts and subtle Bullet Rain target fill.

item.title: v0.1.92 - District 2 Practice guidance and pacing
item.description: Clear interaction and stand guidance, full objective text, faster resolution-based target cadence and separated launch origins.

item.title: v0.1.91 — District 2 entry and Hound introduction
item.description: Combat waits for real arena entry, rear walls close safely, checkpoint view faces forward, and Hound introduction uses one cumulative total.

item.title: v0.1.90 — Mission 1-2: District 2
item.description: District 2 opening combat, Hound introduction, Practice Machine, four Throwers and a survivor-gated exit toward District 3.

item.title: v0.1.89 — District 1 gameplay cleanup
item.description: Reliable Micro-Grenade enemy impacts, pause-safe district titles, Chapter Bullet Rain targeting and clear communications-repair feedback.

item.title: v0.1.88 — Moving Repair Zone Edge Occupancy
item.description: Partially standing over the moving repair zone now counts when the player's physical controller overlaps the visible area.

item.title: v0.1.87 — District 2 transition and checkpoint
item.description: District 1 now leads into a persistent District 2 checkpoint with a safe one-way boundary and restored Chapter progression.

item.title: v0.1.86 — Repair Completion Cleanup Gate
item.description: Clear surviving repair-pressure enemies before Finalize Repairs becomes available.

item.title: v0.1.85 — District 1 Fake Escape, Ambush and Gate Recovery
item.description: A false exit leads into a forty-enemy ambush, ordered lock recovery, and genuine District 1 completion.

item.title: v0.1.84 — District Arrival and Distributed Repair Pressure
item.description: A centered District 1 arrival title, fair spawning across authored regions, and a 15-enemy repair-pressure cap.

item.title: v0.1.83 — Repair Encounter Pressure and Projectile Safety
item.description: First-entry repair pressure, four stronger spawn bands, non-blocking objective zones and DPS passive downtime support.

item.title: v0.1.82 — DPS Aim Alignment and Progressive Repair Pressure
item.description: Primary shots follow the compact crosshair, while District 1 repair pressure increases through three configurable bands.

item.title: v0.1.81 — District 1 Mission Flow: First Half
item.description: Clear the initial threat, repair communications through static and moving zones, and hold the final signal to open the gate.

item.title: v0.1.80 — Reusable Chapter Objective Foundation
item.description: Reusable world/minimap waypoints and rectangular floor zones are ready for development preview, with authored Chapter locations preserved.

item.title: v0.1.79 — Chapter 1-1 Playtest Polish
item.description: Larger player HUD, smaller tighter card choices, sealed gate backing and progressively revealed combat targets.

item.title: v0.1.78 — Chapter 1-1 First Playable Combat Slice
item.description: District 1-1 now plays as a real 10 → 10 → 20 combat sequence, then opens its authored corridor gate after 40 legitimate kills.

item.title: v0.1.77 — Achievement Bonuses Separate from Story
item.description: Story still builds the shared achievement record, while permanent achievement Combat Power now applies only to Endless runs.

item.title: v0.1.76 — Chapter 1-1 First Playable Combat Slice
item.description: District 1-1 now plays as a real 10 → 10 → 20 combat sequence, then opens its authored corridor gate after 40 legitimate kills.

item.title: v0.1.75 — Achievement Bonuses Separate from Story
item.description: Story still builds the shared achievement record, while permanent achievement Combat Power now applies only to Endless runs.

item.title: v0.1.74 — Chapter 1-1 First Playable Combat Slice
item.description: District 1-1 now plays as a real 10 → 10 → 20 combat sequence, then opens its authored corridor gate after 40 legitimate kills.

item.title: v0.1.73 — Card Choice Entrance and Selection Animation
item.description: Larger card choices rise into the bottom-left corner, confirm the selected upgrade, and drop away while gameplay continues.

item.title: v0.1.72 — Objective Notifications Above the Minimap
item.description: Objectives briefly appear above the minimap, then slide behind it, while current objective details remain available in Pause.

item.title: v0.1.71 — Contextual Event Progress and Timer Bar
item.description: Active Story requirements now share a compact top-center display with a persistent event icon, clear progress, and countdown direction.

item.title: v0.1.70 — Larger Player HUD and Chapter District Minimap
item.description: The compact player HUD is easier to read, and the Chapter 1 minimap frames each district while retaining a smooth whole-chapter overview.

item.title: v0.1.69 — Compact Gameplay HUD Foundation
item.description: A compact lower HUD and smaller bottom-right minimap give the game world more room, with a development preview for the new Chapter 1 blockout.

item.title: v0.1.68 — Chapter 1 Map Blockout Prototype
item.description: A separate flat Chapter 1 test scene is ready for first-person evaluation of district scale, corridor width, and travel distance.

item.title: v0.1.67 — Chapter 1 Mission Map
item.description: Offline Story now opens a connected Chapter 1 mission route directly, with automatic campaign saving behind the scenes.

item.title: v0.1.66 — Chapter 1 Mission Progression Framework
item.description: Offline Story now has the Chapter 1 progression foundation for six ordered missions while the current combat remains available as a legacy flow.

item.title: v0.1.65 — Base Critical Damage Balance
item.description: Player Critical Damage now starts at 1.0× instead of 2.0×; existing Critical Damage upgrades still add to that base.

item.title: v0.1.64 — Tighter DPS Multi-Projectile Crosshair
item.description: The DPS primary-fire crosshair is more compact with two or three projectiles, while actual projectile spread stays the same.

item.title: v0.1.63 — Boss Transition No Longer Waits for Cards
item.description: Offline Story now starts the Boss intro after Core 3 without waiting for pending card choices; the offers remain available.

item.title: v0.1.62 — Total Kills Achievement Rebalance
item.description: Rare Total Kills now requires 10,000 account kills and Epic requires 50,000; completed tiers continue showing live numerical progress.

item.title: v0.1.61 — 70-Kill Offline Core Defense
item.description: Each Offline Story Core Defense now completes at 70 legitimate kills instead of 80, with the HUD and resumed progress using the same target.

item.title: v0.1.60 — Faster Damage Popups
item.description: Damage numbers now complete their existing movement and fade animation 25% faster than the previous popup speed.

item.title: v0.1.59 — Responsive FPS Movement
item.description: Ground and air movement now respond quickly to current WASD input while keeping smooth jump momentum and a clear movement-speed limit.

item.title: v0.1.58 — Boss1 Airborne Damage Fix
item.description: Boss1 now ignores player damage while airborne during its Phase 1 jumps and Phase 2 tracking dive, preventing midair defeats.

item.title: v0.1.57 — Shorter Offline Core Defenses
item.description: Offline Story Core defenses now require 80 legitimate enemy kills each, down from 100, with the same rewards and refill pacing.

item.title: v0.1.56 — Core Travel Timer and Minimap
item.description: Offline Story Core travel now starts at 60 seconds, shortens to three seconds near the selected Core, and keeps the broad minimap until Core Defense begins.

item.title: v0.1.55 — Boss1 Phase 1 Attack Clarity
item.description: Boss1's Phase 1 warning cone clears as the directional ground wave launches, and the landing now carries the existing impact camera shake.

item.title: v0.1.54 — Core Defense Target Display Fix
item.description: Offline Story Core Defense now keeps its configured 100-kill target on the HUD from the start, including after resuming a run.

item.title: v0.1.53 — Three Core Encounters Before Boss
item.description: Offline Story now uses three unique Core regions before the existing Boss encounter, preserving the selected route and placement when a run resumes.

item.title: v0.1.52 — Kill-Only DPS Passive
item.description: DPS Progressive Fire now builds Attack Speed only from legitimate enemy kills; the existing 20-second grace and one-stack-per-second decay remain.

item.title: v0.1.51 — Final Explore Batch Completion Fix
item.description: Offline Story's final Red Explore batch now completes only after all issued Red enemies are defeated; the first five section handoffs keep their existing pacing.

item.title: v0.1.50 — Enemy Tracker Projectile Guidance
item.description: DPS Enemy Tracker shots keep their initial aim, then bend toward enemies once they become visible from the projectile's position.

item.title: v0.1.49 — Boss1 Phase 1 Ground Wave Fix
item.description: Boss1's Phase 1 attack now resolves the authored city roads after landing and emits its aimed directional ground wave.

item.title: v0.1.48 — Core Defense Minimap Framing
item.description: Offline Story Core Defense minimaps now frame the selected Core and its full authored enemy spawn area, with steady, aspect-correct coverage.

item.title: v0.1.47 — Faster Floating Damage Numbers
item.description: Floating damage numbers keep their current animation and play through it 10% faster.

item.title: v0.1.46 — Hound Targeting Fix
item.description: Enemy Tracker now follows the Hound's animated body center, making visible-body aiming work reliably from every direction.

item.title: v0.1.45 — Tighter DPS Primary-Fire Spread
item.description: DPS primary-fire projectiles now spread less, with matching aim indicators for every shot.

item.title: v0.1.44 — Offline Story Explore Pacing
item.description: Offline Story's opening Explore advances through six authored 10-enemy batches when two or fewer enemies from the current batch remain. The HUD now shows only EXPLORE.

item.title: v0.1.40 — Offline Story Core Defense Population
item.description: Offline Story Core defenses now run to 100 legitimate kills and refill more quickly as active enemies fall, while keeping the 10-enemy cap.

item.title: v0.1.39 — Offline Story Explore Route and Core Travel
item.description: The opening Explore follows six authored regions, Core travel uses walkable path distance, and the current Core and player-start placements are synchronized.

item.title: v0.1.38 — Offline Story Core Travel and Spawn Fixes
item.description: Core travel now preserves DPS passive timing, defense enemies follow the selected Core's spawn region, and Archive Cores appear at their intended size and placement.

item.title: v0.1.37 — Offline Story Spawn Regions
item.description: Offline Story enemies and Healer Hearts now use the authored spawn areas for each Core location, with improved Boss arena add placement.

item.title: v0.1.36 — Playtest Mode Access
item.description: Story Offline remains playable while Online and Endless are clearly marked under construction in the menu.
